title: Run a plumbing pipe between two points on a level
task: Create a plumbing Pipe between two XYZ points on a level, using Pipe.Create with a PipingSystemType and a PipeType, and read its length back. Covers MEP pipe modelling.

pitfalls.symptom: First() throws InvalidOperationException 'Sequence contains no elements' when collecting PipingSystemType or PipeType.
pitfalls.cause: The open document was created from a template with no plumbing/piping content loaded.
pitfalls.fix: Confirm the FilteredElementCollector for PipingSystemType and PipeType is non-empty before First(); use a Plumbing/Systems template or load pipe families first.
